Theorem
[Linear entropy and maximum volume growth] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0112, page-0113, page-0114 1. ch19:19.34\group Entropy

For a complete noncompact manifold with $\Rc \ge 0$, uniform boundedness of the linear entropies of all heat kernels is equivalent to maximum volume growth: $\Vol B(p,r)\ge cr^n$ for every $p$ and $r$. Under maximum volume growth, \[ \inf _{t>0}\mathcal W_{\rm lin}(f(t),t)=\lim _{t\to \infty }\mathcal W_{\rm lin}(f(t),t) =\log \operatorname {AVR}(\tilde g). \]
